attorneys: Jacob Kossman argued the cause for petitioner. With him on the brief was David Berger. John R. Benney argued the cause for the United States. With him on the brief were Solicitor General Perlman, Assistant Attorney General Campbell, Robert S. Erdahl and Philip R. Monahan. Emanuel Redfield filed a brief for the American Civil Liberties Union, as amicus curiae, urging reversal.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The judgment is reversed. United States v. Limehouse, 285 U. S. 424; Swearingen v. United States, 161 U. S. 446.
